actions.label: Create the first graph node on the blank canvas
actions.expected: A Prompt node is created only through the visible authoring UI.

actions.label: Capture the UI-authored graph
actions.expected: The first node is visibly authored from a blank document.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Save the untitled UI-authored document
actions.expected: The native Save dialog writes one .ether document.

actions.label: Ctrl+S document save
actions.expected: Ctrl+S opens the native Save dialog for an untitled document.
actions.actual: The Ctrl+S route created the requested .ether file.

actions.label: Save result
actions.expected: The UI-created graph is stored as one .ether file.
actions.actual: Saved UI authored document.ether after Ctrl+S.

actions.label: Inspect the manual save milestone
actions.expected: Document History shows the Ctrl+S manual milestone as a reviewable record.

actions.label: Capture the visible manual milestone
actions.expected: The document history names the manual Ctrl+S milestone.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Close Document History
actions.expected: The history review returns to the document canvas.

actions.label: Save As to a second path
actions.expected: The active document switches only after the new destination is complete.

actions.label: Save a copy without switching
actions.expected: A complete copy is created while the active title remains the Save As destination.

actions.label: Compact the UI-authored document
actions.expected: Compaction reports actual before and after sizes without invalidating the document.

actions.label: Make the UI-authored document portable
actions.expected: The native confirmation completes a zero-reference portability check honestly.

actions.label: Capture completed document actions
actions.expected: Save As, Copy, Compact, and Portable actions have completed on the UI-authored document.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Writer lease before contender
actions.expected: The Save As destination retains one AppData writer lease before the competing process opens it.
actions.actual: Observed one lease for PID 5360 and path hash 859047644462acbeab7a1b26a4d0af2aebba4c92707bd0dfcdc58b61edf474f3.

actions.label: Edit the saved document through the visible UI before a recovery restart
actions.expected: A second node is committed and autosaved before the deliberate process kill.

actions.label: Visible autosave transition
actions.expected: The ordinary graph edit visibly transitions through Saving to Saved.

actions.label: Hard-kill after UI edit/autosave
actions.expected: The exact journey process exits without a clean close, leaving normal AppData recovery state for the next launch.
actions.actual: The journey process was terminated only after the visible two-node graph returned to Saved.
